event: Canadian royal tour: Halifax, Nova Scotia

observations.visualDescription: Short-to-medium hair with soft, slightly wavy feathered ends and a wispy side-swept fringe. The sides reach around the ears and layered ends show at the nape. A hat and veil hide the crown, part, and much of the top.
observations.catalogMatchReasoning: Closest existing concept: short feathered shag. Visible feathered layers and a broken, lightweight perimeter support the match; the hat obscures the crown, so crown lift and the full shape cannot be confirmed.
